texts.preamble: Laxminarya Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 25 April, 2016 1 W.P.7415/14 (Laxminarayan Sharma Vs. State of M.P.) 25.4.2016
texts.arguments: In this writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the validity of the order dated 5.5.2014, by which the penalty of Rs.25,000/- has been imposed on the petitioner for breach of Section 26 and 27 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as the Act). When the matter was taken up today, learned counsel for the respondent submitted that during the pendency of the petition, under Section 70 of the Act, the appellate authority has been notified and the District Judge of the concerned District has been notified as appellate authority. In view of aforesaid submission , Shri Tapan Trivedi, learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that he be granted liberty to file an appeal before the appellate authority.
texts.petitioner_arguments: In this writ petition, the petitioner has challenged the validity of the order dated 5.5.2014, by which the penalty of Rs.25,000/- has been imposed on the petitioner for breach of Section 26 and 27 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as the Act). When the matter was taken up today, learned counsel for the respondent submitted that during the pendency of the petition, under Section 70 of the Act, the appellate authority has been notified and the District Judge of the concerned District has been notified as appellate authority. In view of aforesaid submission , Shri Tapan Trivedi, learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that he be granted liberty to file an appeal before the appellate authority.
